## Problem and resulting behavior

What user problem does this change address? Link an issue if one exists.

## Evidence

For behavior changes, include the smallest synthetic example and expected
result. List the checks actually run and any checks you could not run.

## Review notes

- [ ] Examples and content are independently authored and safe to publish under the publication policy.
- [ ] Calculation assumptions, privacy limits, and affected documentation still match the behavior.
- [ ] Any site version or receipt compatibility change is explained, if applicable.
